## Source preservation

- [ ] The patch is focused and preserves attribution, original editions and relevant objections.
- [ ] Added fixtures are synthetic or explicitly authorized for this repository; no secrets or protected private content are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and regression coverage match the change.

For a partial or shared acceptance criterion, link the issue without automatically closing it.
